profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary: As a versatile and results-oriented engineer, I bring a wealth of experience in creating innovative products from scratch and architecting robust solutions at enterprise scale. My journey includes co-founding companies where I embraced a start-up mentality, leading teams to deliver cutting-edge solutions installed in thousands of homes. I have successfully led teams building scalable microservices, and driving the technical vision for various domains. My passion lies in pushing boundaries, fostering collaboration, and instilling excellence in every project I undertake.

positions.title: Co-founder & CTO
positions.description:
PlayDate (http://www.startplaydate.com) is on a mission to improve the lives of pets and pet owners through technology. Leveraging cutting-edge AI, PlayDate will process and use the data collected to create products and features, such as automated play and exercise tracking, ultimately allowing pets to lead longer and healthier lives.

Our first product, the PlayDate Smart Ball, allows pet owners to interact with their pets remotely. Every pet owner wants to play with their pet when they're not at home. Our remote controlled ball enables a user to play with their dog from anywhere. A camera inside the ball allows owners to see where the ball is going and their dog, creating a truly interactive way to play.
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Python (Programming Language) · JavaScript · Microsoft Azure · Machine Learning · Django REST Framework

positions.title: Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
PINCHme is the leading digital hub for CPG manufacturers to acquire new customers and increase sales in a fun and engaging way, offering brands the opportunity to get their products into the hands of their ideal consumer through targeted and data-driven sampling. 

PINCHme leverages its 5.5 million member community to build brand awareness, understand market penetration, collect ratings & reviews to be syndicated to retailer websites, amplify social media engagement, and ultimately drive sales (both online and in-store).
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Ruby on Rails · JavaScript · Backbone.js · HTML5

educations.fieldOfStudy: Cognitive Science: Computational Modeling (AI), Minor In Computer Science
